root_cause: Repository migration filename 20260920111000_admin_composio_key_onboarding.sql did not match the actual production Supabase migration identity 20260920112118_admin_composio_key_onboarding after direct production application.
prevention: Production migration history is authoritative for an already-applied migration identity.
If a production migration is applied before repository reconciliation, the repository filename must be updated to the exact production version before terminal closure.
Never rewrite production migration history merely to fit a stale repository filename.
Terminal migration readback must compare both exact version and exact name.
